sources.behavior: input returns the line read from the port's readline provider; input/eval/exec are capability gated
eval and exec compile and execute source in positional argument zero; optional globals/locals must be actual dicts

model_signature_contract: eval/exec source is positional index zero; all three positional-only parameters are retained in models, with optional globals/locals defaults elided
coverage_gaps: Unverified against supported target-aware Pyrefly/Pysa output
Other input channels and dynamic code entry points are not modelled
No general code-execution sanitizer guarantee is established
